title: Pure Shining Sarcophagus
summary: Shining Sarcophagus and the monsters that mention it, with generic staples. The monsters come from several archetypes, but each one names Shining Sarcophagus and needs it on the field, so they count as one theme here. The Continuous Spell searches any card that mentions it, every turn, and sends back monsters they revive from the GY. Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice, the newest card, summons itself by discarding and searches the Sarcophagus. Gadget Trio searches the Sarcophagus or a Spell/Trap that mentions it. Silent Magician Zero negates Spells, Silent Swordsman Zero negates targeting, and Moremarshmallon takes every attack. Gandora-G pays half your LP to wipe the board and summon a monster that mentions the Sarcophagus from the Deck. Ties That Bind locks the Extra Deck, so it holds only generic Rank 4s and Links.

main: Shining Sarcophagus
Continuous Spell: searches a card that mentions it every turn; sends back revived monsters.
Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice
Newest: summons itself by discarding and searches Shining Sarcophagus.
Gadget Trio
Searches Shining Sarcophagus or a Spell/Trap that mentions it; sets Stronghold when destroyed.
Silent Magician Zero
Negates a Spell while you control the Sarcophagus; grows with their draws.
Silent Swordsman Zero
Negates targeting of the Sarcophagus and its monsters; grows each Standby Phase.
Moremarshmallon
Takes every attack; summons itself on their turn and the next copy when destroyed.
Archfiend's Advent
Normal Summons without Tributing; steals a monster until the End Phase.
Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction
Pays half your LP to wipe and banish, then summons a Sarcophagus monster from the Deck.
Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic
Summons itself while the Sarcophagus is on the field; returns when destroyed.
Future Silence
Quick-Play: searches a monster that mentions the Sarcophagus; refills hands in battle.
Ties That Bind
Summons two Level 4 or lower Sarcophagus monsters from the hand or Deck.
Turn Silence
Quick-Play: raises a Level and negates a monster effect; ends the Battle Phase from the GY.
Stronghold the Hidden Fortress
Trap Monster that grows with each Sarcophagus card; destroys an attacker.
Dark Magic Mirror Force
Destroys their Attack Position monsters and protects your Sarcophagus monsters.
